confidence.rationale: The official site and its location-specific Toast links conclusively establish that the frozen source is U-Street while the target is Tenleytown. The packet also contains internally contradictory risk metrics and Terra erased explicit positive allergen evidence from matched products.

confirmedFindings: The seven affected baseline items are 56:fried-chicken, 59:gios-fried-chicken-bowl, 60:gios-fried-chicken-burrito, 61:hot-dark-roast-coffee-12oz, 62:hot-dark-roast-coffee-decaf-12oz, 74:korean-beef-yuca-loca, and 101:telera-pan-torta. All belong to the 13-item missing-from-Tenleytown reconciliation group.
All 113 baseline items were reconciled once: 83 exact matches with allergen mismatches, 17 variant matches with allergen mismatches, and 13 missing-from-source items marked accurately unavailable.

The configured frozen source identifies Bandit Taco New Hampshire Avenue at 1946 New Hampshire Ave NW, whereas the scoped restaurant is Tenleytown at 4629 41st St NW. The location/source mismatch and resulting catalog drift are confirmed.

The Tenleytown Toast catalog contains FOOD, Beverage, and FOOD (3PD), plus current products absent from the frozen baseline. FOOD (3PD) is substantially a duplicate service presentation and does not independently prove additional unique products.

No complete restaurant-issued allergen guide, complete ingredient inventory, may-contain policy, or cross-contact policy was found. Therefore the menu cannot support allergen negatives, complete allergen arrays, or cross-contact conclusions.

The deterministic count-drift, baseline-only, non-exact-reconciliation, low-confidence, scout-risk, source-authority, and allergen-source-gap concerns are valid in substance. Cross-contact remains unverifiable rather than affirmatively present or absent.

The deterministic metrics are stale or internally inconsistent: they report 113 baseline-only and 113 non-exact items with zero current products, while Terra reports 83 exact matches, 17 variants, 13 missing items, and 21 additional-current-product records.
rejectedFindings: Terra's grouped adjudication that assigns empty contains-allergen arrays to all 100 exact or variant matches is rejected. The linked Tenleytown menu explicitly names ingredients such as cheese, sour cream, flour tortillas, eggs, panko, and flour, while product identities such as fish and shrimp support narrow positive evidence.

Terra's broad treatment of matched products as allergen mismatches cannot justify erasing valid explicit positives. Those positives must remain partial and must not be promoted into complete allergen arrays.
Any implication that empty arrays for the additional products establish allergen absence is rejected. They represent unavailable or partial evidence, not negatives.

The packet's routing statement that Terra reported baseline allergen mismatches is not reflected by the deterministic allergenMismatchItemCount of zero; that metric is rejected as inconsistent with the 100 mismatch dispositions.

The official-linked Tenleytown catalog confirms the target address, enumerates FOOD, Beverage, and FOOD (3PD), and provides numerous explicit but incomplete ingredient positives.
The frozen baseline URL currently identifies Bandit Taco New Hampshire Avenue at 1946 New Hampshire Ave NW and includes location-specific products absent from Tenleytown.
